role: Chairman, Landmark Society of the Niagara Frontier
stance_basis: paraphrased as compiling a list of historic structures, with no opposition or support stated
summary: Mr. Olaf Shelgren, Jr., as Chairman of the Landmark Society of the Niagara Frontier, is mentioned in the EIS as having collaborated with the Buffalo Historical Society to compile a list of historic structures along the proposed rail alignment. The Landmark Society identified six additional sites beyond the three already on the National Register as meeting criteria for inclusion. No explicit opposition to or support for the project is attributed to Mr. Shelgren or the Landmark Society; their role is presented as informational and consultative.
complaint_summary: Mr. Olaf Shelgren, Jr., representing the Landmark Society of the Niagara Frontier, collaborated with the Buffalo Historical Society to compile a list of historic structures along the proposed rail alignment, with the Landmark Society identifying six sites as eligible for the National Register of Historic Places.
summary_quote: The Buffalo Historical Society (under the direction of Dr. Walter S. Dunn, Jr.) and the Landmark Society of the Niagara Frontier (represented by Mr. Olaf Shelgren, Jr., Chairman) compiled a list of historic structures located along the proposed rail alignment.
